zh.name: B站纯净专注套装
zh.description: 移除首页推广轮播与直播浮窗、清理播放页右侧推广卡片，并增加 [ ] / \ 键盘倍速快捷键。

mods.name: B站首页去广告与浮窗
mods.description: 隐藏首页首屏商业轮播推广卡片、客户端下载浮窗及活动角标。

mods.name: 播放页右侧栏精简
mods.description: 隐藏播放页右侧游戏/漫画广告与活动卡片，完整保留选集列表与合集目录。

mods.name: HTML5 视频倍速快捷键（[ / ] / \）
mods.description: 按 ] 加速 +0.25x，[ 减速 -0.25x，\ 一键还原 1.0x，右上角弹出轻提示。

en.name: Bilibili Zen Focus Pack
en.description: Hide home promo clutter and watch-page ad cards while adding [ / ] / \ HTML5 video speed hotkeys.

mods.name: Clean Home Feed Promos
mods.description: Hide sponsored feed cards, app download popups, and login nag floaters.

mods.name: Streamlined Watch Sidebar
mods.description: Hide right-rail ad and live promo boxes while keeping multi-part playlists visible.

mods.name: HTML5 Speed Hotkeys ([ / ] / \)
mods.description: Step playback speed with ] (+0.25x), [ (-0.25x), and \ (reset 1.0x) with a corner HUD toast.
